alpha_presentation.gameplay_policy: The fully transparent gameplay center transitions through a feathered alpha blend into the dark recessed screen treatment. The blend is presentation framing and does not define the emulated game's aspect ratio.

source_reference: final human-approved RetroVault SNES Classic production visual
notes: Final human-approved premium showroom SNES master preserved.
Partially transparent pixels preserve the approved soft CRT-style screen blend on all four sides.
Outer molded SNES-inspired housing remains fully opaque.
No permanent illuminated runtime hardware indicator is required by the static alpha contract.
RetroVault branding and secondary Nintendo platform identification remain visually distinct.
Final production geometry is frozen at X438 Y71 W1044 H783 on a 1920x1080 canvas.
RetroVault owns physical viewport geometry; Guest/GDV owns CRT image treatment.
The approved native CRT preset is activated with RetroArch --set-shader.
Game-authored internal black regions are preserved and do not alter system-level geometry.
